title: Split core message domain modules
description: Break message.rs into component, chain, session, sink/result, provider request, and event modules while preserving the unified message API.

files.change: Move component enum and component helpers.
Move chain construction, text/media extraction, and validation helpers.
Move event state and event-level provider request/result accessors.

criteria: message.rs or message/mod.rs becomes a facade.
MessageChain and MessageEvent public API remains compatible.
Workspace tests pass after downstream imports are updated.

implementation_steps: Create message/ submodules and move types in dependency order.
Preserve public re-exports from the message facade.
Update internal imports in pipeline/platform/web/provider tests.

result.summary: astrbot-core message.rs became a facade module tree; components, chains, session/sender metadata, sink, result/stream, provider request/tool DTOs, event state, and tests now live in focused modules.
